verdict.rationale: A probe shows the smolagents docs are served as raw markdown (guided_tour.md returns HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at clean, agent-readable doc pages. However, the llms.txt probe returned 404, so there is no index file for agents to discover the docs. The OpenAPI probe concerns the Hugging Face Hub, not smolagents, and is not credited. Missing for 10: an llms.txt index (or llms-full.txt), any explicitly documented agent-oriented docs offering, and confirmation that markdown variants exist across all doc pages.
